messages:
jamie: Heads up — seeing slow memory growth on long-chat runs today, looks tied to KV slot churn + a kernel selection change from yesterday. Can we sketch short observability changes to triage?

yuki: Can you paste the high-level numbers? residency / evictions / hit rate?

jamie: Quick dump from a repro run (10k steps, seq=4096):
```
kv_slots_total: 131072
kv_slots_used: 109234
kv_residency_pct: 83.4
kv_slot_reuse_ratio: 0.42
kv_evictions_total: 6482
kv_fragmentation_index: 0.28
mem_rss_mb: 47632 -> 48812 over run
last_kernel_choice: large-batch-opt-v2
```
Not huge numbers but residency slowly trending down as fragmentation climbs and evictions increase per long session.

oliver: Interesting. I think the kernel selector started favoring large-batch-opt-v2 for seq>2048 after the heuristic tweak. That variant coalesces KV writes differently, could be leaving more gaps (slots) unused. We should measure reuse by slot-age and by contiguous-coalesce ratio.

maria: Agree. Proposal: add these prometheus metrics (names tentative):
- `kv_slot_fragment_index` (gauge 0..1)
- `kv_slot_age_histogram` (histogram buckets in seconds)
- `kv_slot_reuse_ratio` (gauge)
- `kv_evictions_by_shard_total{shard}` (counter)
- `kv_residency_percentiles` (summary or separate gauges p50/p90/p99)
Also tag requests with `kernel_variant` label so we can correlate.

jamie: +1. Also need an eviction delta counter with per-minute rate and a `eviction_cause` label (age / mem-pressure / manual) so we can attribute.

yuki: For dashboards:
- heatmap: slot age vs reuse ratio over time (per kernel_variant)
- stacked time-series: evictions_by_shard, residency_pct, p99 latency (long-context bench)
- small panel: fragmentation_index and mem growth slope for active sessions
- table: top kernels by correlation to low residency (r>0.4)

oliver: Implementation notes: increment `kv_evictions_by_shard_total` at C++ eviction path, and emit `kv_slot_reuse_ratio` from sampler code. The age histogram needs lightweight tagging in the sampler to avoid perf overhead.

maria: Alert suggestions:
- residency_pct drop >10 percentage points in 5m for any customer -> page oncall
- eviction rate increase >200% baseline in 10m -> info alert to eng-runtime channel
- fragmentation_index > 0.45 for 15m -> warn and schedule deeper trace

perf-ci: perf-regression detected at 1719004700: long-context p99 tokens increased +7% after kernel selector change, benchmark id=lc-4096-2026-03-20

jamie: That lines up with the timing. Can someone add `kernel_variant` label to the perf traces and to the runtime metrics tonight so we can split postmortem data? smaller PR ok, we can iterate.

oliver: I can own the metric PR (C++ + exporter). Will add `kernel_variant` tagging on the request context and a lightweight sample in the eviction path. ETA EOD my timezone.

maria: I'll make a quick dashboard mock in Grafana and add the three primary panels (heatmap, stacked time-series, fragmentation + mem slope). Will drop the link once done.

yuki: For triage runbook: if we see residency drop + perf regression -> compare kernel_variant distribution, check `kv_slot_age_histogram` for increase in young empty slots -> if confirmed, revert kernel choice or roll out a canary with `large-batch-opt-v1` for 10% of traffic.

infra-bot: deploy: serverless/runtime-kernel-selector@2026-03-20 rolled at 1719004550 by oliver — triggered canary to 100%

jamie: thanks. putting this on the sprint board as `kv-slot-observability` and tagging oliver/maria. will follow up with repro steps and full logs.

maria: Link to deltas when dashboard ready: (will post) :eyes:

perf-ci: ci-note: long-context regression baseline pinned at run 1718999000; look for kernel_variant split in traces

jamie: Perfect. Next steps: oliver metric PR, maria dashboard mock, yuki runbook update. We'll reconvene after initial telemetry lands.
